System Console.note: Existing translations overwhelmingly use 'systemkonsolen' (definite form) / 'systemkonsol'. Capitalize as 'Systemkonsolen' when used as a named UI area at sentence start or in titles.

marketplace.note: Usage is split: 'Marketplace' (kept in English, majority) vs 'marknadsplatsen'. Keep 'Marketplace' as the named in-product store; definite form 'Marketplace' unchanged.

team.note: Neuter loanword: ett team, teamet, team (pl.), teamen. Majority of existing strings keep 'team'; a legacy minority uses 'grupp' — avoid 'grupp' here since it is needed for 'user group' (användargrupp).

post.note: Existing translations render both 'post' and 'message' as 'meddelande' (majority). 'inlägg' appears in some admin strings (e.g. 'Schemalagda inlägg'); prefer 'meddelande' for consistency.

thread.note: en tråd, tråden, trådar. Threads view: 'Trådar'.

direct message.note: Majority rendering. A couple of legacy strings use '(Privat meddelande)' — do not reuse. Sidebar category: 'DIREKTMEDDELANDEN'.

notification.note: Existing usage is inconsistent: 'notifiering' (majority), 'avisering', 'meddelande'. Keep 'notifiering' for consistency; 'avisering' is the standard Swedish OS-level term and would be the better choice in a coordinated cleanup. Never use 'meddelande' (collides with 'message').

pin.note: Inconsistent today: the action is 'Fäst i kanal' but the list is 'Nålade meddelanden'. Prefer 'fästa'/'fäst' (imperative 'Fäst') throughout; unpin = 'ta bort fäst meddelande'/'lossa'.

bookmark.note: Noun: 'bokmärke' (ett bokmärke, bokmärken). Verb: 'bokmärka' or 'lägga till bokmärke'.

saved messages.note: UI title: 'Sparade meddelanden'. save = 'spara', unsave = 'ta bort från sparade'.

scheduled post.note: Existing strings use 'schemalagda meddelanden/utkast' and admin title 'Schemalagda inlägg'. Prefer 'schemalagt meddelande' to align with post/message = 'meddelande'.

emoji.note: en emoji, pl. 'emojier' (or invariant 'emoji'). NOTE: existing sv.json frequently misspells this as 'emoij' — always use 'emoji'.

custom emoji.note: Existing uses 'Anpassad emoij' (typo) and 'Egna emoij'. Use 'anpassad emoji'.

reaction.note: en reaktion, reaktioner. Verb: 'reagera'. Existing has typo 'rekationer' — do not copy.

away.note: Status label: 'Borta'. A legacy string uses 'Tillfälligt borta'.

online.note: Existing is inconsistent: 'Uppkopplad', 'Ansluten', 'Online'. Prefer 'online' (invariant, standard Swedish) — it also pairs naturally with 'offline'.

out of office.note: Existing UI uses 'Ej tillgänglig'. A more literal option is 'inte på kontoret'/'frånvarande', but keep the established term.

channel admin.note: Existing has typo 'Kanaladminstratör' and role-vs-activity mixup 'Kanaladministration' — use 'kanaladministratör' for the role.

sign in.note: Use 'logga in' for both 'sign in' and 'log in'. Noun: 'inloggning'.

sign out.note: Use 'logga ut' for both 'sign out' and 'log out'.

join.note: 'gå med i' a channel/team (Gå med i kanalen). Calls uses 'anslut' for joining a call — keep those distinct.

unarchive.note: Existing is very inconsistent: 'avarkivera', 'återställ ... från arkiv(et)', 'dearkivera', 'packa upp', and even a mistranslation 'Arkivera kanaler' for 'Unarchive Channel'. Standardize on 'avarkivera'.

mute.note: Existing majority uses the anglicism 'mjuta' (Mjuta/mjutad) for channel mute; a minority uses 'tysta'. Keep 'mjuta' for consistency, though 'tysta' is more standard Swedish and would be the better choice in a coordinated cleanup.

unfollow.note: Existing: 'Sluta följa tråden'. Avoid the calque 'avfölj' seen once in Playbooks.

favorite.note: Noun: 'favorit'; sidebar category 'Favoriter'. Verb: 'markera som favorit'; unfavorite = 'ta bort från favoriter'.

webhook.note: Kept in English, common gender: en webhook, webhooken, webhooks/webhookar.

trigger word.note: Established rendering in existing translations (9 of 11 strings).

plugin.note: Kept in English (majority): ett plugin, pl. 'plugins' or 'plugin-program'. 'tillägg' appears in a minority of strings — avoid.

seat.note: Existing renders licensed seats as 'platser' ('antalet platser i din licens').

trial.note: Majority rendering ('prova-på-period', 48 strings); 'testperiod' is a significant minority (23). Keep 'prova-på-period'.

workspace.note: en arbetsyta, arbetsytan, arbetsytor. Majority rendering; some strings keep 'workspace'.

subscription.note: Majority; billing copy sometimes uses 'abonnemang' ('Köp ett abonnemang'). Prefer 'prenumeration'.

invite.note: Verb: 'bjuda in' (imperative 'Bjud in'). Noun sense: use 'inbjudan'.

sidebar.note: Majority rendering ('sidofältet'); a few strings use 'meny'/'sidopanel' — prefer 'sidofält'.

attachment.note: en bilaga, bilagor. 'bifogad fil' also acceptable in running text.

channel header.note: Inconsistent today: 'kanalens sidhuvud' (most common), 'kanalhuvudet', 'rubrik', 'header'. Standardize on 'kanalens sidhuvud' / 'sidhuvud'.

persistent notification.note: Very inconsistent today: server uses 'persistenta notifieringar'; webapp variously 'återkommande/varaktiga/upprepade aviseringar'. Standardize on 'persistent notifiering' (pl. 'persistenta notifieringar') to match notification = 'notifiering'.

recap.note: No existing sv translation (new feature). 'sammanfattning' matches how related AI summaries are rendered; if a distinct word is needed to avoid clashing with 'summary', use 'återblick'.

agent.note: en agent, agenter. Mobile strings often say 'AI-agent' — acceptable where the AI context is not obvious.

burn-on-read.note: UI labels use 'Bränn vid läsning' / 'BRÄNN VID LÄSNING'. One admin title uses 'Förstör meddelanden efter läsning' — prefer 'bränn vid läsning'.

magic link.note: Existing usage is split 50/50 between keeping 'Magic Link' and 'magisk länk'. Prefer the Swedish 'magisk länk' (en magisk länk, magiska länkar).

personal access token.note: As used in existing UI ('ett personligt åtkomst-token'). A cleaner compound would be 'personlig åtkomsttoken'; keep the existing form for consistency.

announcement banner.note: Majority rendering; one permissions string uses 'System-aviseringar' — avoid.

channel banner.note: Existing strings phrase it as 'kanalens banner'; use 'kanalbanner' as the compact term.

collapsed reply threads.note: Mobile consistently uses 'Sammanfällda svarstrådar'; one legacy webapp string says 'Dialog med Svarstrådar' — prefer the mobile rendering.

data retention.note: Existing consistently uses the Swedish records-management term 'gallring' (gallringspolicy, gallringsjobb, gallringsschema); literal 'datalagring' appears only twice. Data retention policy = 'gallringspolicy'.

onboarding.note: Majority keeps 'onboarding'; 'introduktion' appears in a minority of strings.

Town Square.note: Existing server translation of the default channel name is 'Torg'. Keep as-is for consistency with existing servers; 'Torget' would be more idiomatic.

Off-Topic.note: Existing server translation is 'Orelevant' (a misspelling of 'Irrelevant'). Prefer 'Off-topic', a common loanword in Swedish forums; 'Utanför ämnet' is an alternative.
